title: Simulation 3D Physics Vehicle
text: Implement controllable 6DOF vehicle 3D environment, 4 inputs, 5 outputs, {Type, PassVehMesh} sets Type Muscle; {Color, VehColor} sets the color of vehicle, {Name, ActorName} sets the name of vehicle, {Initial position [X, Y, Z], InitialPos [m]} sets the vehicle initial position, {Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw], InitialRot [rad]} sets the vehicle initial rotation, {Mass, Mass [kg]} sets the vehicle mass, {Center of mass offset vector, CgOffset [m]} sets the offset in center of mass, {Inertia tensor scaling vector, IvehScale []} sets the scaling of inertia tensor, {Chassis height (used in drag), ChassisHeight [m]} sets the height of chassis, {Drag coefficient, Cd []} sets the vehicle drag coefficient, {Drag lift coefficient, Cl []} sets the longitudinal lift coefficient, {Path to custom mesh, MeshPath} sets the path to custom mesh, {Track width, TrackWidth [m]} sets the distance between wheels, {Wheel base in custom mesh [m]}, {Front Wheel radius, FrntWhlRadius [m]} sets the front wheel radius, {Front wheel width, FrntWhlWidth [m]}, {Rear Wheel radius, RearWhlRadius [m]} sets the rear wheel radius, {Rear wheel width, RearWhlWidth [m]}, {Motor torque indices, TrqCrv [Nm]} sets the motor torque indices, {Motor speed breakpoints, SpdCrv [rpm]} sets the motor speed breakpoints, {Maximum powertrain speed, MaxRPM [rpm]}, {Powertrain rotational inertia, Jmot [kg*m^2]}, {Powertrain damping at full torque request, bEngMax [Nms/rad]}, {Powertrain damping at zero torque request in gear, bEngMin [Nms/rad]}, {Drivetrain type} sets the drivetrain Rear Wheel, {Front to rear torque split ratio, FrntRearSplit []}, {Transmission type} sets the transmission, {Gear number vector, G []} sets the gear number, {Gear ratio vector, N []} sets the gear ratios, {Upshift speed, UpShiftRPM [rpm]}, {Downshift speed, DownShiftRPM [rpm]}, {Minimum (idle) speed, MinRPM [rpm]} sets the minimum powertrain speed, {Shift time, tShift [s]} sets the time taken to complete shift, {Final drive ratio, NDiff []}, {Transmission efficiency, eta []} sets the efficiency factor, {Steering type} sets the option to set steering, {Outside to inside steering ratio, SteerAngleRatio []} sets the outside to inside steer angle ratio, {Front wheel max steer angle, FrntWhlMaxSteer [rad]} sets the front wheel max steer, {Rear wheel max steer angle, RearWhlMaxSteer [rad]}, {Maximum steering ratio breakpoints, SteerCrv []} sets the maximum steering ratio, {Steering ratio speed breakpoints, SteerSpdCrv [m/s]} sets the steering ratio speed breakpoints, {Maximum front wheel torque, FrntWhlMaxTrq [Nm]}, {Maximum rear wheel torque, RearWhlMaxTrq [Nm]}, {Option to enable handbrake input} enables handbrake input, {Front wheels affected by handbrake} sets the handbrake option for front wheels, {Rear wheels affected by handbrake} sets the handbrake option for rear wheels, {Maximum front wheel hand brake torque, FrntWhlMaxHndBrkTrq [Nm]}, {Maximum rear wheel hand brake torque, RearWhlMaxHndBrkTrq [Nm]}, {Front suspension force offset location, FrntSuspFOffset [m]} sets the front suspension force offset, {Maximum front suspension compression (jounce), FrntSuspMaxComp [m]}, {Front spring preload, FrntSpringPreload [N]} sets the front suspension preload force, {Front spring stiffness, FrntSpringRate [N/m]} sets the front suspension spring, {Maximum front suspension extension (rebound), FrntSuspMaxExt [m]}, {Front suspension damping ratio, FrntSuspDamping []} sets the damping ratio of front suspension, {Front roll bar stiffness scaling, FrntRollbarScaling []} sets the front anti-roll effect, {Rear suspension force offset location, RearSuspFOffset [m]} sets the rear suspension force offset, {Maximum rear suspension compression (jounce), RearSuspMaxComp [m]}, {Rear spring preload, RearSpringPreload [N]} sets the rear suspension preload force, {Rear spring stiffness, RearSpringRate [N/m]} sets the rear suspension spring, {Maximum rear suspension extension (rebound), RearSuspMaxExt [m]}, {Rear suspension damping ratio, RearSuspDamping []} sets the damping ratio of rear suspension, {Rear roll bar stiffness scaling, RearRollbarScaling []} sets the rear anti-roll effect, {Enable anti-lock braking} sets the option to enable anti-lock braking, {Enable traction control} sets the option to enable traction control, {Front wheel corner stiffness, Cy_f [N/rad]} sets the front cornering stiffness 70e3, {Front wheel slip modifier, FrntSideSlipModifier []} sets the front slip modifier, {Rear wheel corner stiffness, Cy_r [N/rad]} sets the rear cornering stiffness 70e3, {Rear wheel slip modifier, RearSideSlipModifier []} sets the rear slip modifier, {Friction scaling factor, lambda_mu []}, {Enable light controls} sets the option to control vehicle lights, {Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor} sets the headlight color, {High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity}, {Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity}, {High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle}, {Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle}, {Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation} sets the left headlight beam orientation, {Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation} sets the right headlight beam orientation, {Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity}, {Reverse light intensity, ReverselightIntensity}, {Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity}, {Period, SignallightPeriod} sets the turn signal light period, {Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth}, {Sample time, SampleTime}, {Output location and orientation} sets the option to return location and orientation and {Output nominal vehicle state feedback} sets the option to return nominal vehicle state. Values come from the instance.
